20% Mannitol is a hypertonic solution at 1100mOsm/L.

Administration of 500ml of 20% would result in the following:

CVS

Expansion of Plasma volume with distribution to ECF, ICF contraction 

↑ plasma osmolarity 

↑Preload secondary to fluid bolus, ↑plasma volume From bolus and fluid movement from ICF

Adverse: May precipitate cardiac failure in susceptible patient, after effect of hypovolaemia after diuretic effect 

CNS

Osmotic dehydration of CNS with ↓ICP and brain volume 

Adverse: Brain compensation idiogenic osmosis may result in rebound cerebral oedema 

Endocrine:

Activation of Osmoreceptors → activation of RAAS

Renal 

↑ Urine output secondary to osmotic diuretic effect

Adverse: 

↑renal plasma flow rate → washout of medullary interstitial gradient and decreased ability to concentrate urine

→ loss of electrolytes Na/K
